data.name: MediaStageDescription
data.value: A call scene: one large main item and up to six thumbnails, the main one switched by a click or from the keyboard. Every item keeps its element when the main one changes, so a video keeps playing. Wide, the thumbnails sit in a column beside the main item; narrow, in a row below it that scrolls sideways.

data.name: MediaStageCountDescription
data.value: From none (an empty stage) to seven (one main item and six thumbnails); with one there is no thumbnail strip.

data.name: MediaStagePreviewDescription
data.value: Click a thumbnail, or Tab to its "Show large" button and press Enter, to make it the main item. Resize the window to see the layout follow the width of the stage.
